question: What characterizes the knower who still performs proper ritual observances?
premises: The knower's seed of worldly bondage has ended.
These qualities belong to the same subject.
inference: A knower whose seed of bondage has ended may still perform proper rites.
uncertainties: This verse is syntactically linked to the preceding verse's argument.
plain_english: This applies to the knower whose seed of worldly bondage has ended, yet who still performs proper rites.
